ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $AD$ is the altitude to side $BC$. Within this triangle, there is an inscribed rectangle $PQMN$, with one side lying on $BC$, and the other two vertices respectively on $AB$, $AC$. If $BC=60$ and $AD=40$, find the lengths of the sides of rectangle $PQMN$ when the area of $PQMN$ is maximized.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let $PN=x$, \\
then $DE=PN=x$, $AE=AD-DE=40-x$, \\
since $\triangle APQ \sim \triangle ABC$, \\
we have $\frac{AE}{AD}=\frac{PQ}{BC}$, i.e., $\frac{40-x}{40}=\frac{PQ}{60}$, \\
thus $PQ=60-\frac{3}{2}x$, \\
therefore, the area of rectangle $PQMN$ is $PQ \cdot PN= \left(60-\frac{3}{2}x\right)x$ \\
$= -\frac{3}{2}x^{2}+60x$ \\
$= -\frac{3}{2}(x-20)^{2}+600$, \\
when $x=20$, the area of rectangle $PQMN$ reaches its maximum value of $600$, \\
at this point, $PN=20, PQ=60-\frac{3}{2}x=60-\frac{3}{2}\times 20=30$. \\
Therefore, the dimensions of the rectangle are $\boxed{30}$ and $\boxed{20}$.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure is triangle ABC, the base BC is horizontal, and A is above; AD is perpendicular from A to BC, with foot D. Rectangle PQMN is inscribed in the triangle, the base NM lies on BC, the upper-left vertex P is on AB, the upper-right vertex Q is on AC, the top side PQ intersects AD at E, and PQ is parallel to BC. Then reason: Let the height of the rectangle PN = h. Because the rectangle's base is on BC, the top side PQ is parallel to BC, and AD is perpendicular to BC, so DE = PN = h. Given AD = 40, therefore AE = AD - DE = 40 - h. From PQ ∥ BC in the figure, △APQ ∼ △ABC can be obtained, so PQ/BC = AE/AD. Substituting BC = 60 and AD = 40 gives PQ/60 = (40 - h)/40, therefore PQ = 60 - (3/2)h. The area of the rectangle A(h) = h·PQ = h(60 - (3/2)h) = -(3/2)h^2 + 60h. This is a quadratic function opening downward, and the area is greatest at the vertex, h = -60/(2·(-3/2)) = 20. At this time PQ = 60 - (3/2)·20 = 30. Therefore, when the area is greatest, the side lengths of the rectangle are 30 and 20.
